journal_lines: Spider on the ceiling. Didn't give it a chance.
Web across the path. Spider behind it.
Two of them. Handled in order.
Eight eyes watching from above, and none of them surprised.
Walked into the web before I saw it. The strands hum when you pull at them.
Old web in a corner, full of things older than the spider that made it.
It dropped on a thread of its own silk. I dropped it back.
The legs kept moving after the body stopped. Old habits.
A whole nursery of them in a side passage. Walked the long way around.
Silk thin as breath. Strong as wire.
Eyes catching torchlight. Then not catching it.
